BIFF7 import now preserves external cell/range and name identities using document- and worksheet-specific link tables; 32 original-record regressions, 12 compiled SDK replays and eight scoped Shell cases pass. BIFF7 export remains open.

Explicit host passwords support XOR, standard RC4 and CryptoAPI imports and exports. Independent XOR decryption matches 152 streams from 114 SDK exports; msoffcrypto reads all 76 BIFF8/DSF primary streams.
